column2: [intro]
I’ve never had a passion for virtuosity,
For me, it’s better to play without anxiety.
Perfect notes don’t make me thrill,
I’m here to have fun, just enjoying the thrill.
No need to be a pro, let me make it clear,
What matters is having fun, no need for cheers.
We’ll act like rockstars, living the dream,
Forget about virtuosity, it’s not our scene.
When I sing, it’s always offbeat,
Serious lyrics never caught my heat.
I prefer words that bring a smile,
To make the crowd dance and stay awhile.
No need to be a pro, let me make it clear,
What matters is having fun, no need for cheers.
We’ll act like rockstars, living the dream,
Forget about virtuosity, it’s not our scene.
